title: Female Graduate Portrait, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Full-length black and white snapshot depicting a young woman standing proudly in her academic graduation attire, including a gown, cap, and tassel. She is posed against a tall red brick building with windows and landscaping at the base. The photograph features deckled (serrated) edges typical of mid-century film processing. A handwritten date on the back notes June 19, 1947, placing this event in the post-WWII American higher education expansion era.
